messages:
alex.sales: quick rundown — Acme POC is ready to sign, but legal flagged MSA + DPA redlines. they insist on HSM-backed KMS and pushed Net60 payment terms. security questionnaire not fully answered. need signature routing + whether finance will accept Net60 without a PO. looping in @maya.legal and @jane.finance.

maya.legal: thanks alex. main legal asks: (1) remove unlimited liability language in Sec 9, (2) DPA: customer wants subprocessor carveouts and a 3rd-party HSM assurance clause, (3) countersign by exec required for Net60. can legal get redline comments on MSA PDF?

acme.poc: hi all — correct on HSM requirement, we use a hosted HSM and need proof of key separation. net60 is standard for our procurement. happy to do exec countersign if needed. we can also route via our buyer (PO available once countersigned).

ravi.engineering: on the HSM note — we can supply an HSM/KMS integration checklist and a short architecture diagram. for POC we can run Redwood Private in their VPC with KMS integration, or Dedicated with HSM binding. ops will need 2 days to stand this up.

jane.finance: Net60 without PO is risky for FY close. finance policy: Net60 accepted only if signed SLA + initial invoice scheduled and AR team notified. otherwise Finance requires a PO before provisioning. if sales wants an exception, need VP approval.

tom.solutions: proposed compromise: sign orderform + MSA with a clause that initial provisioning is contingent on PO within 30 days, otherwise provisioning paused. customer gets POC access for 2 weeks. works for both sides?

maya.legal: that clause is fine but we need to avoid creating a unilateral remediation right. i'll draft an amendment: short clause 'Provisioning contingent on issuance of PO within 30 days; failure to issue will result in suspension of non-billable trial resources only.' will also add DPA subproc carveout language and HSM attestation requirements.

alex.sales: thanks. what's the shortest signature path? customer prefers DocuSign. can we do countersign by exec + vendor e-sign? any special routing for dual-signature?

deploybot: automated note — internal signature flow templates: 
1) Orderform (sales) -> countersign (exec) -> DocuSign envelope created.
2) MSA redlines (legal) -> final MSA PDF uploaded -> DocuSign separate envelope.
Use envelope ids: OF-3821119000 and MSA-3821119000.

jane.finance: if we go DocuSign, finance needs invoice terms on the orderform matching Net60 and a billing contact email. also prefer invoice milestone: 50% on countersign, 50% on PO receipt.

alex.sales: here's a minimal orderform snippet i drafted, pls approve/edit: 
```
Orderform: Acme Corp POC
SKU: POC-Dedicated-30d - $12,000
Add-on: HSM-Integration (one-time) - $2,500
Payment terms: Net60 (50% due on countersign; remaining due on PO issuance)
Notes: Provisioning contingent on PO within 30 days
```

maya.legal: looks fine, i'll add MSA signature block for exec countersign and a DPA exhibit with subproc carveout. will ping SOC2 reviewer re: HSM attestation.

ravi.engineering: i'll attach the KMS integration checklist here after code freeze. small note: for Dedicated + HSM we need customer KMS endpoint + certs.

acme.poc: sounds good. we'll get the buyer ready to issue a PO once exec countersigns. can you send the DocuSign envelope to buyer@acme.com and cc procurement@acme.com?

alex.sales: will do. final ask for the thread — @maya.legal to upload the redline MSA and DPA when ready, @jane.finance to confirm invoice milestone language, and @ravi.engineering to post the KMS checklist. i'll create the DocuSign envelopes once legal confirms PDFs. :thumbsup:
